business_problem: Vicki Holman explains the approach: “In terms of deployment, we just want to move really quickly. With the initial project team licenced, we had a couple of weeks to become experts ourselves!”
solution_summary: Hargreaves Lansdown is the UK’s number one platform for private investors, employing over 2,000 people. They are trusted by more than 1.7 million clients who together invest over £120 billion. The business was keen to explore the potential of artificial intelligence and, especially, Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365. The response from users has been fantastic, with improved accessibility and significant productivity savings. As the UK’s number one platform for private investors, Hargreaves Lansdown prioritises digital innovation as a source of competitive advantage and driving improvements in the customer experience. When it saw an opportunity to explore the potential of artificial intelligence and, in particular, Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 , the business jumped at the chance.
